versions.content: An EcuInstance is defined as top level PNC-Coordinator for a specific PNC if all involved Phys- icalChannel s (according to [TPS_SYST_03080]) only refer to Communication- Connector s aggregated at that EcuInstance , where CommunicationConnector . pncGatewayType is set to active .
